name: Cooperative Breeding: A Betaological Perspective
source:
The Cotemate Accords brought forward an unprecedented initiative to ensure the continuation of productive and non-dysgenic alpha and omega coupling, and preserve the genetic diversity of the 3rd Galactic Cardinal's Migrant Fleet amidst the 'alpha drain' created by its ongoing state of war.

[From [url=https://dianerds.itch.io/cooperative-breeding]itch.io[/url]]
